figures.title: Figure 6.
figures.caption: Principal Component Analysis. Projection of the genetic data from six Pommerœul samples and two Tongeren samples whose data are newly reported in this study onto genetic variation from 999 modern West Eurasians. For comparison, projected data is shown from relevant ancient groups bounded by polygons: abbreviations correspond to Western Hunter-Gatherers (WHG) and Linearbandkeramik (LBK).
